raw_response:
Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which is characteristic of a massive right pleural effusion pushing structures away; pneumothorax would appear radiolucent (dark), and consolidation typically does not cause such a significant shift or would pull towards the side of collapse.
